definitions.dose_response: higher_priority_first among pairs where the higher-priority probe was sent later by the bucket's gap; batches whose first send was at or after their window's measured start
definitions.earlier_sent_first: pairs with different send times: share where the earlier-sent probe precedes
definitions.higher_priority_first: pairs with different agave_priority: share where the higher-priority probe precedes
definitions.p_perm: two-sided permutation p-value, positions permuted within each batch-block (null rate 0.5)
definitions.tau_priority: Kendall tau_b of priority vs position per batch-block, +1 = higher priority earlier
definitions.tau_send: Kendall tau_b of send time vs position per batch-block, +1 = earlier sent earlier
definitions.units: attribution by block producer; family = producer clientId in the snapshot nearest the window
